# apicurio_artifact_rule (Resource)

A rule on one artifact; it takes precedence over the group and global rules of that type, and `config = "NONE"` switches the type off for the artifact even when a global or group rule is set. The artifact must exist (an `apicurio_artifact`). On a secured registry artifact rules need the developer role. Rules are applied when a version is created and when a draft leaves `DRAFT`, never to existing versions. See the provider documentation for the precedence of rules and their maturity per artifact type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A rule for one artifact; it takes precedence over the group and global rules.
resource "apicurio_artifact_rule" "price_compatibility" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
  rule_type   = "COMPATIBILITY"
  config      = "BACKWARD"
}

# NONE switches a rule type off for one artifact even when a global or group
# rule is configured. Versions created later are not checked.
resource "apicurio_artifact_rule" "legacy_no_validity" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.legacy.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.legacy.artifact_id
  rule_type   = "VALIDITY"
  config      = "NONE"
}

# Rules are applied to versions created after them: make the versions depend
# on the rule so that Terraform orders the operations.
resource "apicurio_artifact_version" "price_v2" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
  version     = "2.0.0"
  content     = file("${path.module}/schemas/price-2.0.0.avsc")
  depends_on  = [apicurio_artifact_rule.price_compatibility]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (String) Artifact the rule belongs to. Changing it replaces the rule.
- `config` (String) Configuration of the rule, validated against `rule_type`: `VALIDITY` takes `NONE`, `SYNTAX_ONLY` or `FULL`; `COMPATIBILITY` takes `NONE`, `BACKWARD`, `BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE`, `FORWARD`, `FORWARD_TRANSITIVE`, `FULL` or `FULL_TRANSITIVE`; `INTEGRITY` takes a comma-separated set of `REFS_EXIST`, `NO_DUPLICATES`, `NO_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES` and `ALL_REFS_MAPPED`, or `FULL` or `NONE` alone. Changed in place.
- `group_id` (String) Group the rule belongs to. Changing it replaces the rule.
- `rule_type` (String) `VALIDITY`, `COMPATIBILITY` or `INTEGRITY`. Changing it replaces the rule.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `group_id/artifact_id/rule_type`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Artifact rules are imported by "group_id/artifact_id/RULE_TYPE".
terraform import apicurio_artifact_rule.price_compatibility payments/price/COMPATIBILITY
```
